name: FlyBy:Love
source:
Flyby:Love is a hard sci-fi romantic drama set 500 years in the future. After his girlfriend is killed in a terrorist bombing, Tomoya drops out of college and is conscripted into the military.

But the bombing was just the beginning! Over the next two years, civil war breaks out between the central government and anti-regulation forces.

Tomoya, now an aircraft mechanic, is still burdened by the death of his high school sweetheart. He arrives for his new position at the Kifune Airforce Base which is unknown to him actually a penal unit! Will this unconventional workplace be the death of him and is this bodacious group of latent criminals really humanity's last hope?!
